title: Add or change the recovery e-mail
summary: Adds or changes the recovery e-mail on a signed-in phone (ADR 0057). An owner check comes first (security.md rule 14, tier 3). The server sends a link; the e-mail counts as a way back only after the person opens it.

phase.description: confirmIdentity: the owner check. editing: the field. sending: PUT /v1/me/email runs. sent: bipe_email_sent with the address. failed: see error.

email.description: The field text. Starts with email_pending, else the verified email, else empty.

current.description: The verified recovery e-mail from GET /v1/me/account. Shown under the title; absent shows bipe_account_email_none.

pending.description: email_pending from GET /v1/me/account: shows bipe_email_pending under it.

emailInvalid.description: true after send when the address is not plausible. Shows bipe_signup_email_invalid.

error.description: bipe_error_email_taken, bipe_error_email_unavailable, bipe_error_network, bipe_error_rate_limited or bipe_error_generic.

confirmIdentity.effect: Asks for the device owner check with bipe_email_change_reason. A pass sets editing; a fail or cancel closes the screen. A phone with no passcode and no biometrics asks for the app lock PIN when the lock is on, else goes on (the same rule as pin-change).

editEmail.effect: Sets email, clears emailInvalid and error.

send.effect: Checks the address locally, then PUT /v1/me/email with email and the app language (pt or en). 202: sets sent and reloads the account state. 409 email_taken: failed with bipe_error_email_taken. 503 email_unavailable: failed with bipe_error_email_unavailable. 429: bipe_error_rate_limited. 400: emailInvalid. Other: bipe_error_generic or bipe_error_network.

notes: Opens from the e-mail row of the Ways back group in settings (registries/settings.json waysBack.email) and from the recovery-reminder card.
The verified address stays in use until the new one is confirmed (api/openapi.yaml /v1/me/email). The server sends the link and, after a change, a notice to the old address.
The address is never logged. The app does not keep it on the phone; it reads it from GET /v1/me/account.
Remove (DELETE /v1/me/email) is not on this screen: removing a way back needs its own spec with the same owner check.
